WAVE product updates — 29 July 2026

A focused consistency release across staff Relationships, NDA artifacts, and the repreneur deal journey.

Production build 10.124e177 · update built from the 21–28 July UI/UX milestone review, accepted scope, and live QA evidence.

Release summary

Eight practical improvements make the newest WAVE workflows clearer to scan and act on.

Each update below pairs the original production state with the released production result, then explains the change, its user impact, and the verification completed.

Eight fixed 50/50 before/now pairs
IU-002 was absorbed by UX-007

The inactive signed-copy controls no longer render when no pursuit exists, so their disabled-button styling no longer needs a separate update.

What changed

The release implements the accepted consistency pass identified in the 21–28 July UI/UX milestone review: reachability, hierarchy, progressive disclosure, state clarity, and restrained metadata emphasis.

Scope

Staff Relationships and NDA artifact workflows, plus the repreneur shortlist, memo-lock explanation, and decision response. The canonical PDR remained the scope authority.

Verification approach

  • Focused automated coverage, TypeScript, design policy, lint, and production build checks.
  • Approved staff and repreneur QA personas only; no send, upload, submit, verification, or real-record mutation.
  • Desktop and 390 px mobile workflow checks for the affected views, with production screenshots captured below.

Released product updates

Every update uses the same strict 50/50 comparison: the original production experience on the left and the released production experience on the right.

8 updates · 16 production screenshots
UX-001Released product update

Relationships now makes Firms and Contacts reachable

What changed

The Relationships workspace now has reachable, searchable Firms and Contacts directories. Direct legacy URLs redirect to the equivalent canonical view rather than opportunity intake.

Why it matters

Staff can browse the firm and contact foundation without losing context or silently starting a new opportunity.

Verified

Staff desktop and 390 px mobile: visible navigation, direct routes, and firm search.

UX-002Released product update

The repreneur deal list is now a compact ranked shortlist

What changed

Portal deals now use compact ranked rows with the decision state, key metrics, location, and a clear route to detail. The long narrative remains available after opening a deal.

Why it matters

Repreneurs can compare several opportunities before committing attention to a full profile, especially on mobile.

Verified

Repreneur desktop and 390 px mobile: list order, filters, detail routes, and public-field scope.

UX-003Released product update

Memo locks now explain the actual confidentiality state

What changed

Portal memo messages now distinguish confidentiality evidence pending from Re-New document approval pending, while keeping the existing server-side download gate unchanged.

Why it matters

The next step is understandable without weakening confidentiality control or exposing staff-only evidence.

Verified

Repreneur detail states: confidentiality pending, legacy not-required with waiver pending, and document approval pending. A legacy not-required label still requires an explicit recorded waiver.

UX-004Released product update

Mobile Relationships starts with the timeline

What changed

The desktop filter layout stays visible, while mobile moves filters into an All filters disclosure with an active-filter summary and prioritises the first relationship event.

Why it matters

The primary review job is visible immediately without making filters harder to find or reverse.

Verified

Staff 390 px mobile: first timeline event, All filters disclosure, active-filter summary, and no horizontal overflow.

UX-005Released product update

Activity capture now separates required evidence from follow-up detail

What changed

Record activity shows the required evidence first, places follow-up fields in Optional details, and keeps Cancel and Record activity in the dialog footer.

Why it matters

Recording a factual interaction is faster and clearer on both desktop and mobile without changing the data captured or sending email.

Verified

Staff desktop and 390 px mobile: required fields, optional disclosure, fixed action footer, keyboard focus, and cancel-only QA.

UX-006Released product update

Not a fit now expands only when it is chosen

What changed

The decline flow begins as a secondary Not a fit action. Selecting it expands the existing required rationale form and focuses its first control.

Why it matters

The default response state stays balanced and easier to scan while preserving the complete, validated decline workflow.

Verified

Repreneur desktop and 390 px mobile: default actions, deliberate form reveal, focus placement, and no-submission QA.

UX-007Released product update

Inactive NDA signed-copy controls are now concise state summaries

What changed

With no active pursuit, WAVE keeps the Blank NDA form available and replaces the two signed-copy upload forms with compact locked summaries. The full controls return when a pursuit exists.

Why it matters

The Pursuit tab now reflects what can be acted on, without changing evidence history, versioning, or access semantics.

Verified

Staff Pursuit tab in a no-active-pursuit state, with no upload or record mutation. IU-002 was absorbed here: inactive signed-copy buttons no longer render.

IU-001Released product update

Timeline metadata now recedes behind meaningful verification state

What changed

Routine email, direction, and delivery metadata now reads as compact inline context. Failed delivery remains destructive and Owner to verify retains a restrained warning treatment.

Why it matters

The timeline has a cleaner hierarchy while preserving the signals that need operational attention.

Verified

Staff Relationships timeline on desktop and mobile, including failed delivery, Owner to verify, and Verify mine states.

Release notes

  • No product data model, confidentiality access rule, or server action was loosened in this consistency pass.
  • UX-003 clarifies state; it does not make document approval alone sufficient for memo access.
  • UX-007 replaces inactive signed-copy controls with state summaries and preserves evidence history.

Source and limits

  • Before images preserve the milestone-review evidence; now images are captured from the released production state.
  • This is a focused team release summary and not a complete accessibility conformance audit.
  • Lightbox image inspection remains available; no responses, filters, exports, or browser-stored decisions are included.
